title: Verizon says it is "aware of an issue impacting wireless voice and data services for some customers", as thousands of users report no cellular reception (Jacob Krol/TechRadar)
summary: Jacob Krol / TechRadar: Verizon says it is “aware of an issue impacting wireless voice and data services for some customers”, as thousands of users report no cellular reception — Seemingly ‘SOS’ is replacing network bars — While Verizon had a good few months, with the last major outage occurring in October 2024 …
contentText:
Jacob Krol / TechRadar :

Verizon says it is “aware of an issue impacting wireless voice and data services for some customers”, as thousands of users report no cellular reception   —  Seemingly ‘SOS’ is replacing network bars  —  While Verizon had a good few months, with the last major outage occurring in October 2024 …
